A '''Quarantine Enforcement Cruiser''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] tasked with maintaining a quarantine in times of disease outbreak. In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], the starship ''[[Lycoming]]'' served as a Quarantine Enforcement Cruiser.
